source.title: LMS-based continuous reference percentiles for 14 laboratory parameters in the CALIPER cohort of healthy children and adolescents
source.sourceVersion: Owner-supplied final-article Supplementary Table 3; workbook bytes identified by SHA-256.
source.table: Supplementary Table 3: numerical L,M,S-for-age; FSH_M and FSH_F only
source.access: Full final primary article and all three owner-supplied supplementary tables reviewed.
source.redistribution: Only FSH numerical facts, provenance and qualification metadata are extracted; full article, figures and source workbooks/documents are not redistributed.

population.name: CALIPER healthy Canadian children and adolescents
population.location: Greater Toronto Area and The Hospital for Sick Children, Toronto
population.design: Cross-sectional age- and sex-specific model of previously collected CALIPER reference data
population.numberCaution: Approximately 1500 describes the source cohorts across the cited CALIPER studies, not an FSH, sex-specific or 16–19-year participant count. Those subgroup counts are not supplied in these four documents.
population.recruitment: Schools/community clinics (0–<19 years), plus metabolically stable SickKids outpatient clinics (0–<5 years); under-1-year participants excluded from these models.
exclusions: Acute illness in the previous week
Prescribed medication, including oral contraceptives, within the preceding two weeks
population.unreportedContext: The supplied documents do not state Tanner- or cycle-phase-specific FSH modeling, morning-only endocrine sampling or a fasting requirement. Missing information is not a confirmed absence in the patient.

assay.name: Abbott ARCHITECT
assay.platformScope: Article reports ARCHITECT ci2000 and c8000 across all analytes; endocrine/fertility assays cite Konforte 2013 (reference 34).
assay.handling: Serum-separator tubes, centrifuged/aliquoted within 8 hours, stored at −80 °C until analysis.
assay.lowerLimitOfQuantificationNote: FSH LLOQ is not reported in Supplementary Table 1; do not substitute zero, the low QC concentration or another platform's LLOQ.
assay.harmonization: No numerical equivalence to Siemens IMMULITE, Roche cobas, AutoDELFIA or other FSH methods is established. Source selection does not establish the patient sample's assay or specimen.

model.responseScale: native FSH IU/L; no logarithmic back-transform
model.p50Definition: Exact median of the positive-response, normalized BCCG distribution at each exported age node (qBCCG(0.5)), not automatically M.
model.quantileAlgorithm: For L>0, Z=Phi^-1(1-0.5*Phi(1/(S*abs(L)))); for L<0, Z=Phi^-1(0.5*Phi(1/(S*abs(L)))); Y=M*(1+L*S*Z)^(1/L). For L=0 the p50 limit is M.
model.sourceFormulaLimitation: The paper prints the untruncated nominal-z LMS formula, which returns M at z=0; its stated GAMLSS BCCG family normalizes a truncated normal. The exact normalized p50 independently reproduces Figure 1C; source M is preserved separately and never relabeled as the exact normalized median.
model.figureVerification: Figure 1C, printed page 1108 / PDF page 4, black 50th-percentile curves. Vector checks at ages 16, 17 and 18 agree within graphical precision; these checks are diagnostics, not substituted numerical source values.
model.maleCode: gamlss(hormone~cs(age, df=3), sigma.fo=~cs(age, df=2), nu.fo=~cs(age, df=2), family=BCCG, data=d)
model.femaleCode: gamlss(hormone~cs(age, df=2), sigma.fo=~cs(age, df=0), nu.fo=~cs(age, df=0), family=BCCG, data=d)
model.sourceCodeLocation: Supplementary Table 2, FSH male and female rows
model.noNewClinicalFunction: This extraction qualifies only educational age-reference medians. It does not activate BCCG-derived RI, SDS, patient percentiles, diagnosis or treatment decisions.

interpolation.terminalRow: Age 19.0 is retained as a numerical interpolation endpoint only. It does not authorize a patient reference at age 19 or older.
interpolation.rule: Exact exported nodes reproduce normalized BCCG p50. Any between-node PCHIP is a separately documented application approximation, not the original fitted GAMLSS object or interpolation of L/M/S.

useConstraints: Only FSH is imported. This source extract does not activate LH, estradiol, testosterone, AMH, inhibin B or INSL3.
A policy-defined late-adolescent window may use these data without Tanner or cycle-phase questions. It is not a Tanner- or phase-specific reference.
Do not infer an early-follicular, fasting or early-morning reference from absent restrictions.
Known incompatible patient method or specimen and known treatment/pregnancy/stimulation remain exclusions under the application policy; missing context stays unknown.
Do not average or calibrate CALIPER values with neighboring Madsen or adult-reference data, and do not move the source marker to the educational line.
The full source age grid is evidence, not authorization to replace existing infant, childhood, puberty-comparison or adult profiles.
No age uncertainty crossing a source boundary may be resolved by silently selecting the midpoint age.
